original_acceptance.scope: Original bounded driver gates; passive traces are diagnostic evidence
failures: Load driver process or step failed

save_snapshot_custody.scope: Copied file bytes are independently bound to manifests and capture receipts. Live failure/quiet files were read separately and are not an atomic checkpoint. Restore checks compare retained original fields; success-only completion checks use completed-autosave.json and final profile receipts. Gallery UI opening is not part of this driver.
save_snapshot_custody.final_slot_limit: A successful original Load executes the unchanged driver's final source-slot hash guard. There is no separate final source-slot copy on success; retained live copies prove their individual observation times only.

ending_order_timeline.scope: Trace rows stay in the original stdout order; native records stay in original events.json order. Root order is reconstructed from same-record Godot node identities. The root CanvasLayer ancestor of the caption is observed; canonical layout metadata and EndingScene's local recovery-panel visibility are not explicit trace fields.
ending_order_timeline.timing_limit: Godot ticks and native driver elapsed timers have different origins. Unix/UTC wall times provide approximate context only; no cross-clock duration or provider publication causality is inferred.

diagnostic_observations.scope: One canonical Load stdout only. No secondary stream is counted and no nested profile totals are added together.
diagnostic_observations.sampling: At most seven records per layer: two natural notifications per kind, one text-start, one text-finish and one follow-up. Natural notifications remain eligible after follow-up. Missing/capped records do not prove absence of later events.
diagnostic_observations.identity_limit: Godot window IDs, object IDs and accessibility RIDs are internal. No mapping to HWND or UIA RuntimeId is established by these records.
diagnostic_observations.interpretation_limit: Game-side accessibility setter records show executed calls, not successful publication of a complete native provider subtree. The passive trace does not qualify original player gates or a fresh performance comparison.

source_scope: All 30 retained reference and candidate sources are independently pinned. Full repository ancestry/tree identity additionally relies on the externally reviewed commit pins and the pinned controller's checkout guards; this ZIP is not a complete Git object database.
verifier_exit_scope: Exit status qualifies archive/source custody, retained harness checks and the focused suite. Original native journey failure, unexecuted native modes and diagnostic observations remain separate; exit 0 does not mean native acceptance.
